summary: Process switch `test_engines` (`single` | `partitioned`), single by default, so every default output and every bound instruction is unchanged. A Verification Contract may declare `test_partition_command`, `test_engines` and a `Test Partitions` table (partition, groups, profile), all or none, with optional `shared_profiles`; `operation_compile.py check` refuses a partial declaration, a group of `test_groups` in no partition or in two, an undeclared group and a shared profile the table does not use, and an Environment Contract may declare the same `test_engines`. At `partitioned`, with the partition command declared and every engine provisioned by the Environment Contract, `delivery_verification.py run --kind test` runs each partition in its own private clone with `AGENTROF_TEST_PARTITION`, a JSON file holding the candidate hash, the partition, its groups, its engine and the reused test ids, `AGENTROF_TEST_ENGINE` and its own scratch directory, longest first by its last recorded duration, never two partitions of an exclusive profile on one engine at once and never more partitions than engines, under the Item's environment lock until the last one ends. A failing partition, or one that cannot start, never stops another; one record lists every partition's engine, exit code, intactness, duration and output, its exit code is 0 only when every partition passed intact, and its identity binds the plan, the partition command and the declared environment, not the schedule. Evidence approval refuses a record that lacks a partition, holds one twice, holds a failed or not intact one or ran another command. No other command receives the two partition variables, an inherited one included. `regression-run` and diagnostic runs stay one command. In one measured project, QA's final gate ran 227 minutes for 166 cases on one engine, which was busy for at least 64% of the Delivery's wall clock.
